notice.en: Automated collection of postings is best-effort and may miss items — please confirm directly on the official job boards below.

context.ko: 시드 워치리스트(data/postdoc_watchlist.json)의 그룹 페이지와 잡보드를 매주 확인해 채웁니다. 2026-11-23 확인 결과: 마감이 지난 워릭 WMG(11월 22일)·사우샘프턴 섬유형 전지(11월 16일) 공고를 내렸습니다. jobs.ac.uk ‘battery’ 검색(24건)에서 케임브리지 화학과 나트륨 전해질 합성 포닥(Wright·Grey, 12월 15일 마감), 워릭 물리학과 operando 전기화학 TEM 연구원(12월 10일 마감), 엑서터대 배터리 원료 순환경제 포닥(2027년 1월 13일 마감)을 새로 열어 확인하고 올렸습니다 — 케임브리지 공고가 생겨 ‘Grey 그룹 공고 없음’ 카드는 이 공고로 대체했습니다. 레스터대 재활용 공고는 jobs.ac.uk 개별 공고 주소(DTO552)로 바꿨습니다. 리버풀대 Arca 그룹 operando XPS 포닥은 jobs.ac.uk 공고(DTM068)가 여전히 ‘게시 중단’으로 넘어가 ‘재확인 필요’를 유지했습니다. Ceder 그룹 모집, Sandia·Argonne 게시물, 코번트리 공고, Integrals Power(Faraday 잡보드)는 그대로입니다. MEET는 ‘현재 공석 없음’, HIU는 0건, 옥스퍼드 공학과 공고 목록에는 배터리 포닥이 없었습니다. ECS 잡보드와 UCL 채용 페이지(Faraday 잡보드의 UCL Research Fellow 2건)는 이번에도 자동 접속이 차단(403)돼 확인하지 못했습니다. flag가 붙은 PI 중 범위(미국·영국·독일) 안의 Yi Cui(스탠퍼드)·Partha P. Mukherjee(퍼듀대)는 웹 검색으로 공개된 포닥 공고를 찾지 못해 ‘아카이브 2회+’ 항목은 추가하지 않았습니다.
context.en: This list is filled each week by checking the group pages and job boards in the seed watchlist (data/postdoc_watchlist.json). Checked on 23 November 2026: the Warwick WMG role (closed 22 November) and the Southampton textile-battery role (closed 16 November) were removed. The jobs.ac.uk ‘battery’ search (24 results) turned up three new roles, each opened and added: a Cambridge Chemistry postdoc in sodium battery electrolyte synthesis (Wright and Grey, closing 15 December), a Warwick Physics research fellowship in operando electrochemical TEM (closing 10 December) and an Exeter postdoc on UK battery raw-material circularity (closing 13 January 2027) — the Cambridge posting replaces the ‘no Grey-group posting’ card. The Leicester recycling role now links to its own jobs.ac.uk listing (DTO552). The Liverpool operando XPS postdoc in Elisabetta Arca’s group stays at ‘needs re-check’: its jobs.ac.uk listing (DTM068) still redirects as ‘no longer advertised’. The Ceder group’s recruitment, the Sandia and Argonne listings, the Coventry role and the Integrals Power role (Faraday board) are unchanged. MEET states it has no open vacancies, HIU lists none, and Oxford Engineering Science’s vacancy list has no battery postdoc. The ECS job board and UCL’s jobs pages (the two UCL Research Fellow roles on the Faraday board) again refused automated access (HTTP 403) and could not be checked. Of the flagged PIs inside the US/UK/Germany scope, web searches found no public postdoc posting for Yi Cui (Stanford) or Partha P. Mukherjee (Purdue), so no ‘2+ in archive’ item was added.

items.desc_en: As of 23 November 2026 the page still states that graduate student and postdoctoral positions are available, in three areas: computational design of energy materials, experimental synthesis and characterisation, and machine learning and AI. Its ‘Postdoctoral Positions’ subpage says theory postdocs are hired on a rolling basis. Starting dates are negotiable, and applications go to separate addresses for computational (ceder-hr-comp@lbl.gov) and experimental (ceder-hr-exp@lbl.gov) roles.

Experience synthesising air-sensitive (especially main-group) compounds is required; electrochemistry training is provided. Posted on 18 November and closing on 15 December, it is funded for two years in the first instance (£33,662–£46,970, ref MA51743); on 23 November 2026 it was listed on both jobs.ac.uk and the department’s job board.
